comment.narrative: CT coordination mechanism endorsed by the Government

The coordination mechanism is not adopted yet. However work is ongoing for its definition and establishment.a In September 2022 the study visit to Spain CITCO of the SG of the Council of Ministers was crucial for the Lebanese government to decide on the need to develop an interagency coordination mechanism.b In December 2022 the project concluded successfully the organisation of a High Level Seminar on Inter Agency Coordination with senior CT experts from the governments of Spain France Italy and the EU Council Secretariat. This high level seminar provided the opportunity to Lebanons CT specialised bodies to identify and understand the different models for coordination of intelligence agencies in Spain Italy France and the EU and their cooperation with other key actors such as specialised courts dealing with terrorism the Ministry of Foreign Affairs the President and Prime Ministers Office of France and Spain. Despite the difficulties of establishing a coordination mechanism in the country the Prime Minister confirmed during the conference his political commitment to create a system to coordinate the CT intelligence agencies.
